Two layers draw the picture:

- **Intro.** `intro/into-the-dot.html` runs in its own frame, frozen on its own clock. Each frame YOURA sets its view (from the gyroscope or a drag) and asks it to render one moment.
- **Home.** The intro's last scene keeps running behind the tiles, with its scripted camera cancelled so the planet stays put while you look around. The tiles are drawn over it in a transparent WebGL canvas, with the same field of view, so they sit in the same world. Their labels come from a canvas atlas.
